overview_description.description: Origami Therapeutics is developing medicines that target and degrade disease-related proteins as a means of treating disease. They're a preclinical biopharmaceutical company determined to find innovative treatments for neurological disorders, starting with Huntington's disease. Their new protein degraders digest and eliminate disease-causing proteins by utilizing the body's natural protein disposal system. Neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and frontotemporal dementia are the target of its core programs.

about_short_description.short_description: Origami Therapeutics develops protein degrader therapeutics.

product.name: ORICISION™ Drug Discovery Platform
product.description: A platform for discovering protein degraders and conformation correctors targeting disease-causing proteins in neurodegenerative diseases.

product.name: ORIGAMI Protein Degraders
product.description: Small molecule drugs designed to selectively degrade disease-causing proteins by harnessing the body’s natural protein disposal systems.

product.name: Protein Conformation Correctors
product.description: Small molecules that stabilize the proper folding of proteins to prevent toxic misfolding and associated cellular dysfunction.

identifier.value: Human Disease Cell Models for Drug Discovery

product.name: Human Disease Cell Models for Drug Discovery
product.description: In vitro patient-derived cell models, including 2D cultures and 3D brain cell spheroids, used to evaluate and optimize drug candidates for neurodegenerative diseases.
